About the job

🚀 We’re Hiring: Jr. Java Developer | Hyderabad

Aventra.AI is looking for a passionate and motivated Jr. Java Developer to join our growing technology team.

If you’re a Java enthusiast looking to build real-world applications, work with modern technologies, and grow your career in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you!

🔹 Position: Jr. Java Developer

📍 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

💼 Experience: 0–2 Years

🕐 Employment Type: Full-Time

🏢 Work Mode: On-Site

🔧 Key Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Core Java
  • Good understanding of OOP concepts
  • Basic knowledge of Spring / Spring Boot
  • Understanding of REST APIs
  • Knowledge of SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS & JavaScript is a plus
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong willingness to learn and adapt

🎯 What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain Java-based applications
  • Build and integrate REST APIs
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code
  • Work with senior developers on application development and enhancements
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues
  • Participate in code reviews and development discussions
  • Learn and work with modern technologies and development practices

🌟 What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for freshers and junior developers who have a strong foundation in Java, a passion for technology, and the enthusiasm to grow as software engineers.

📩 Interested candidates: Send your updated resume to [email]

Aventra.AI is a next-generation AI consulting and talent solutions company dedicated to helping enterprises accelerate their AI transformation journey. We empower organizations with the right combination of strategic consulting, cutting-edge AI technologies, and highly skilled talent to solve complex business challenges and drive measurable outcomes.

As a trusted AI partner, we specialize in delivering end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and Intelligent Automation solutions. From AI strategy and solution architecture to implementation, deployment, and ongoing support, we enable businesses to adopt AI with confidence and scale.

In addition to consulting, Aventra.AI provides specialized AI and technology talent across contract, contract-to-hire, permanent, project-based, and managed services models. Our network of experienced AI engineers, data scientists, ML engineers, MLOps specialists, prompt engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, and software professionals enables organizations to rapidly build high-performing teams while reducing hiring time and operational risk.

We work closely with startups, mid-market companies, and global enterprises to deliver flexible engagement models that align with their business objectives. Whether organizations need strategic AI advisory, custom AI product development, enterprise AI modernization, or access to niche technology talent, Aventra.AI serves as a long-term partner focused on innovation, quality, and business impact.
